==About==

When growing {{i|Green Bell Peppers}} or {{i|Red Bell Peppers}} in a {{i|Gardening Pot}} there is a small chance that they will instead grow into a {{i|Jalapeno}}. A Jalapeno can '''NOT''' be replanted. A Jalapeno can be stored in a {{i|Bellpepper Sack}}.
